d: Part of the Mexican lagoon, which divides the imperial palace from the Spanish quarter, with magnificent bridge from which they remain united the two floors. You can see the relics of a battle followed. Motezuma with sword to the hand, then Mitrena.
Teutile, then Fernando with followers of Spanish, who descends from the bridge.
Room with workable door in the middle. Motezuma dressed in Spanish, then Teutile, and Ramiro.
Public hearing room with two chairs in the Spanish neighborhood. Teutile, and Asprano.
Chain motezuma with soldiers, and sayings.
Spacious field corresponding to a large bosom of the marina near the camp. Ramiro with Séguito de' Spagna, then Asprano.
Remote part of the city with tower. Ramiro driving out of the Fernando gate, and Soldati. They are seen on the prosthetic door some Mexicans killed.
They sprinkle, following Guastatori, that knock down the gate of the tower, and attack fire for every part.

Temple, where at the bottom you can see the main door closed, on the side the simulacrum of Uccilibos with the altar adorned for sacrifice. Priests to the Mexican, who in white dress guide to the Teutile Ara. Teutile, then Mitrena.
Great square in Mexico City with ornaments for the triumph. Mexican slaves, and flags dropped on one side, on the other the victorious hosts of the Spanish. Fernando, Ramiro, and Teutile.
Motezuma, and Mitrena aside, Aspran shall advance, and sayings.
